## Documents

* [call-context.component.md](call-context.component.md) - Reads what the four checks need about one member's call, once per hook run: its key, its brief, its report, its transcript's writes and its worktree's changes. It judges nothing.
* [check-authorship.component.md](check-authorship.component.md) - Check 1: the files a member's report claims in its output section are the member's own writes. A call whose brief carries no member is not checked, and its result says why.
* [check-frontmatter.component.md](check-frontmatter.component.md) - Check 2: every Markdown file of the kinds the settings name that the member wrote has front matter that conforms. What the member wrote decides whether the check applies, never what its report names.
* [check-ledger.component.md](check-ledger.component.md) - Check 3: the member's call is on the ledger, keyed by agent id, member and attempt. With the capture writing and no record, the result is a fail.
* [check-write-set.component.md](check-write-set.component.md) - Check 4: the member's writes stay inside its write set, read from the worktree's changes and from the transcript's file tools, each path compared in canonical form.
* [disposition.component.md](disposition.component.md) - Records the parent's decision on a failing return check result, the disposition that lifts the gate's stop. It refuses a disposition that lacks what its kind needs.
* [gate.component.md](gate.component.md) - While a failing return check result stands with no disposition, refuses the parent's tool calls, save reads, a stop, a question to the user and the disposition command. A member's tool call never meets it.
* [output-section.component.md](output-section.component.md) - Parses a member report's output section: the files it claims as its output, and nothing else. It is the one home of the section's grammar.
* [results.component.md](results.component.md) - Reads the check results and dispositions a session's ledger holds, for the gate, the disposition script, the context the parent is given and the merge plan. It writes nothing.
* [return-check.component.md](return-check.component.md) - Runs the four checks on a member's report at its hand-back and its stop, and refuses nothing: each result is recorded, a fail with its repair. Its context step hands the parent the results, and its merge plan says which of a writer's paths may come home without asking.
